headline: Did Strong Q2 2026 Results and a US$10 Billion Equity Plan Just Shift Duke Energy's (DUK) Investment Narrative?
summary: Duke Energy reported past second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of US$7,592 million and net income of US$1,092 million, both higher than a year earlier, alongside six-month revenue of US$16,770 million and net income of US$2,642 million. At the same time, Duke Energy outlined plans to issue US$10 billion in common equity by 2030 to fund an extensive capital program focused on meeting rising power demand, especially from data centers, while managing regulatory pushback on spending and...
